news.title: DaisyRose-27B：探索更高效的模型后训练
news.body: RadixArk 发布基于 Qwen 的模型，报告用精选长程智能体任务进行强化学习后训练，并在终端任务等基准中取得改进。成绩属于发布方评测；长训练会话不等同于模型原生上下文长度同步扩大。
news.title_original: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency

news.title: 为什么微调耗时会超过 FLOP 估算
news.body: 作者分析共享 GPU 集群中的实际监督微调任务，讨论仅按浮点运算量估计端到端耗时的局限。该文章为后续论文预览，结论受生产任务样本和硬件环境限制。
news.title_original: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say

news.title: 将时间序列模型接入实时数据流
news.body: IBM 与 Confluent 介绍将时间序列预测、异常检测等能力接入流式数据处理，让输出更接近实时业务流程。服务集成不保证预测准确，也不能替代业务场景验证。
news.title_original: Time-Series Models in the Streamhouse: A New Frontier and Use Cases

news.title: 自带传感器和计算单元的轻型飞行机器人
news.body: MIT 展示携带传感器和计算单元的扑翼微型机器人，可脱离实验室运动捕捉系统进行导航。机器人仍连接外部电源，不能描述为完全无线自主飞行。
news.title_original: This featherweight, flying robot carries its own sensors and computers
news.body_original: The speedy microrobot flies without an attached motion-capture system, moving it closer to applications like agriculture or industrial surveillance.

papers.body: arXiv:2611.23535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained universal machine-learning force fields can reduce the cost of finite-temperature molecular dynamics relative to density functional theory. papers.body: arXiv:2603.15294v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (UMLIPs) offer accuracy close to first-principles calculations at a fraction of the cost, showing significant potential for large-scale material simulations. papers.body: arXiv:2609.01209v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generative models and autonomous agents now propose candidate inorganic crystals by the million, yet most screens test little beyond a minimum-distance cutoff and give no chemical reason for failure. science.title: Confidence-Based Materials Data Quality Assessment via Domain Knowledge and Graph-Structured Learning
science.body: arXiv:2611.23342v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid development of materials machine learning relies on large-scale, heterogeneous datasets, yet model reliability is often compromised by imperfect data from diverse experiments, simulations, and database integration. Real-world materials databases may contain measurement errors, failed calculations, missing or duplicate records, and hidden violations of physicochemical constraints. Such problems are difficult to identify because corrupted samples may remain statistically plausible rather than appearing as explicit outliers.
